name: builder-stall
description: Issue #39 on 26.3: a Builder with a stalled build outlines the cells it is skipping (red can't stand or can't be broken, yellow missing items, blue fluid) for a player holding a Marker or Volume Wrench, and its GUI readout turns dark red with a stalled tooltip. Generated by generators/gen_builder_stall.py, whose docstring describes the rig.

steps.label: load the rig's chunks
window 1600x900 (GUI coordinates below assume it with guiScale 3)
clear and floor
source structure: a ring of stone with a torch in it, two more stones, a torch hanging over air
the floating torch is still there (a popped one would read air)
architect table facing north with its box set and a blank blueprint in
the architect finished its blueprint
chest: the used blueprint in slot 0
run: data modify block {X-6} {Y} {Z-2} Items[{Slot:0b}] merge from block {X-9} {Y} {Z-2} items.out.items[0].stack
item replace entity @p inventory.0 from block {X-6} {Y} {Z-2} container.0

steps.label: site: the ring but for its west cell, the wall outside it, the bedrock, then the water source
Builder facing north: owner, power, torches and no stone
the water has flowed into the torch cell too
viewpoints: barrier blocks to stand on

steps.name: site-before
steps.look: the prepared site before the Builder has a blueprint: a ring of stone with a gap holding water, water inside the ring, one bedrock block above it, no outlines

steps.label: open the Builder
pick the blueprint up from the inventory
put it in the Builder's snapshot slot
cycle the fluid mode once: Do not replace -> Replace fluids
the Builder's fluid mode (expect 1: REPLACE)

steps.name: builder-loaded
steps.look: the Builder holds the blueprint; the resource list shows the stone and torches it needs

steps.label: the server's stall counts: 1 can't stand, 1 can't be broken, 0 refused, 3 missing items, 1 fluid
the stalled cells (box x y z triples) and their reasons (0 can't stand, 1 unbreakable, 3 missing items, 4 fluid)

steps.name: stall-marker-wrench
steps.look: holding a Marker Wrench, seen from the south-west: solid laser cubes round the six stalled cells and none round the built or empty ones. RED x2: the floating torch's cell two above the ring's middle and the bedrock cell on the ring's north-east corner; YELLOW x3: the water-filled cell on the ring's west side and the two stone cells above its north-west and south-west corners; BLUE x1: the torch cell in the ring's middle. The Builder's own hazard-striped box surrounds them all

steps.name: stall-volume-wrench
steps.look: the same view holding a Volume Wrench: the same five outlines

steps.name: stall-empty-hand
steps.look: the same view with an empty hand: NO stalled-cell outlines, only the Builder's own hazard-striped box

steps.name: stall-close
steps.look: closer, Marker Wrench held: red, yellow and blue cubes distinguishable, one per stalled cell

steps.label: open the Builder again

steps.name: builder-stalled-gui
steps.look: the Builder GUI: the Left to Break / Left to Place readout is dark red (stalled)

steps.label: hover the readout

steps.name: builder-stalled-tooltip
steps.look: hovering the readout: a tooltip 'Stalled: 1 can't stand, 1 can't be broken, 3 missing items, 1 held back by fluid'

steps.label: give the Builder stone
the Builder finished what it could and is stalled on the two red cells only
the stalled cells now (box triples and reasons): the floating torch and the bedrock only

steps.name: stall-after-stone
steps.look: after the Builder was given stone: the three stones and the torch in the ring are built, the yellow and blue outlines are gone, only the two red cubes (floating torch's cell, bedrock cell) remain
